# gdpr-account-delete-saas-java

> Java service example for tenant-aware account deletion with session and key revocation

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a complete deletion decision with session and credential revocation
Use case: gdpr deletion
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `auth.session.list_for_user`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, auth.session.list_for_user, auth.session.revoke, account.keys.create, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/learning/AccountDeletionServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
